title: Act
description: An act entity as published in PublicGame.acts (Arkham.Act.Types.ActAttrs). Advancement-cost, key, and card-union payloads remain intentionally broad.

advanceCost.description: The Arkham.Cost required to advance this act. Broad tagged union, out of scope for this contract slice.

breaches.description: Scarlet Keys campaign breach count. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

cardsUnderneath.description: Cards physically stacked underneath this act. Broad card union, out of scope for this contract slice.

keys.description: Arkham keys placed on this act. Broad, out of scope for this contract slice.

modifiers.description: Active modifiers targeting this act. Broad and additive, out of scope for this contract slice.

tokens.description: A Token-keyed multiset, encoded as an array of [tokenName, count] pairs.

treacheries.description: TreacheryId (UUID) values attached to this act.
